gaia-6226694571859532800.x: Resource-rich UNSC Outer Colony and Insurrectionist stronghold in the 23 Librae system.

callisto.x: Frigid, sparsely populated Jovian moon with snowy domed cities and desolate industrial compounds.
Outer Jovian colony and commercial enclave connected by personal teleportation (jaunting) across the warring planetary factions.

hip-71683.x: Early expansion world in the Alpha Centauri system, crucial in the Commonwealth railway network and Starflyer investigation.
Inhabited world orbiting Alpha Centauri A discovered through radio music transmissions, leading to the fateful Jesuit first-contact expedition.
hip-71683.a: Hal Clement, Robert L. Forward, Allen Steele, Poul Anderson

hip-71683.x: Home system of the herd-mind, trunked alien conquerors the Fithp, who journey across interstellar space aboard the generational mothership Thuktun Fithp.
Alpha Centauri destination of the starship Stella Maris, launched by the Order of Saint Leibowitz carrying the memorabilia of human knowledge as Earth undergoes nuclear immolation.
hip-71683.a: Gregory Benford, David Brin, Walter M. Miller Jr.

hip-71683.x: Alpha Centauri colony world, destination of the pioneering Jupiter 2 and the Resolute colonist flotilla in Lost in Space.
Bioluminescent alien biosphere orbiting Alpha Centauri A colonized by ideological factions following the catastrophic malfunction and breakup of the colony ship UNS Unity.

gaia-4330690742322011520.x: Potentially habitable exoplanet Wolf 1061 c, destination of the sleeper colony transport pod in Oxygen.

lhs-1140-b.x: Benchmark temperate world observed with JWST NIRISS and NIRSpec, revealing signatures consistent with a nitrogen atmosphere and secondary ocean.
Temperate habitable-zone Super-Earth 48 light-years away in Cetus, confirmed by JWST to possess a substantial atmosphere.

trappist-1.x: Prime Earth-sized habitable-zone target in the TRAPPIST-1 system subjected to exhaustive atmospheric reconnaissance by JWST NIRSpec and MIRI.
Innermost rocky world of the ultra-compact TRAPPIST-1 resonant chain, receiving four times more stellar flux than Earth and confirmed by JWST MIRI to lack a thick atmosphere.
